sems can 'phrul rtog du ma las
sgra tshig tha snyad gzhi mar yang
bcos pa med pa'i nam mkha' las
tshig 'byung ston pa'i khyad par bzhugs
pad ma las byung sangs rgyas la
dga' byed kyis ni 'di skad gsol
kye kye pad ma'i dbus na bzhugs pa nyid
'di ltar nam mkha' dkyil 'khor la
'od kyi thigs pa 'bum phrag ni
drug cu rtsa bzhi snang ba dang
yang zhun bcu bdun ci yi rgyu
chos kyi sku ni ji lta bu
longs sku zhes pa gang la bgyi
sprul pa'i sku ni gad tsam zhig
sku yi mtshan nyid ci lta bu
bzhugs pa'i tshul ni ci ltar lags
rang bzhin chos nyid sku rnams ci
bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la gsungs
de nas bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang
pad ma'i dbus nas bzhengs nas ni
nam mkha' lding gi phyag rgya mdzad
de nyid mdzad pa tsam gyis ni
chos nyid rang snang nam mkha' las
brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin las
brjod pa'i tshig tu 'di skad du
rang byung byas pa med par byung
kye kye lha yi dbang phyug nyon
'od dkar 'bum phrag drug cu ni
rtsa bzhi yang dag bshad bya'o
rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po las
tshig gi bye brag rnam 'phros pas
sde gsum las ni klong dgur 'gyur
tshig bsdus pa las sho la ka
'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi las
le'u sdong phrag sum cu lnga
bam po nyi khri stong phrag gcig
brjod bya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam
gdul bya'i sems can rtog pa gcod
'di la brjod bya nyer bsdus pas
gzer bu brgya dang brgyad cu la
'gag ni stong phrag phyed dang gnyis
gnad chen 'dus pa stong phrag gsum
gol sgrib khri phrag bzhi bcu la
ming thog rgyud ni khri phrag gnyis
tshig brjod rim pa gsal bkod do
'od kyi yang zhun bcu bdun bshad
rang shar ba rang rang grol dang
rang byung nyid dang rtsal rdzogs dang
mdzes ldan dag dang phra bkod dang
mu tig 'phreng dang yi ge med
snying dang thugs kyi me long dang
nyi zla kha sbyor ngo sprod spras
sku gdung 'bar ba rin chen spungs
sgron ma 'bar dang klong chen drug
de ltar bcu drug rim pa rnams
thal 'gyur las ni nges 'phros nas
gdul yul sems can rnams la snang
bcud 'dus bstan pa 'dzin pas na
bskal pa yod pa 'khor las sgrol
rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mngon snang ba'o
chos kyi sku ni gsung dang thugs
yon tan dang ni phrin las so
sku ni stong dang gsal ba dang
mtshan ma med pa'i rang bzhin no
gsung ni sgra tshig ming bral nas
brjod cing gleng pa nyid bral lo
thugs ni bsam dang 'gyu med pas
'phro zhing spyod pa rnams las 'das
yon tan phyir mi 'ong dang ldog pa med
dbyings dang ye shes khyab pa dang
rang bzhin bcos pa med pa'o
phrin las ma byung ma skyes byas pa med
shugs 'byung ba dang 'gag pa med
ma byas byas pa med pa'o
longs spyod sku yang sku gsung thugs
yon tan phrin las lnga yin no
sku ni snang la rang bzhin med
gsal dang gsal byed rig pas khyab
gsung ni rang byung ba dang rang snang ba
spro bsdu rnam pa'i 'khor lo yi
thugs ni rgyun med gzigs pa dang
mkhyen pa'i rtsal dang dgongs pa'o
yon tan mtshan dpe rdzogs la las
dgongs gsal mngon shes rdzogs pa'o
phrin las chos kyi 'khor lo las
phyi nang gsang ba rnams spros te
so so'i rigs kyi sangs rgyas dang
byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang
rang byung ljags las rnam spros te
'khor la rang gi ngo bos ston
sprul pa'i sku yang sku gsung thugs
yon tan phrin las lnga lnga'o
sku ni mtshan dang dpe byad la
gdul bya gang byung lus sprul pa
gsung ni tshig sbyor legs pa la
tshangs pa'i dbyangs ni yan lag drug
thugs ni shes bya'i ye shes kyis
rang gzhan don gnyis dgongs par gnas
yon tan mkhyen pa rdzogs pa dang
phrin las phyi nang gsang ba yi
mdzad pa ma lus rdzogs pa dang
phun sum tshogs pa lngar gnas pa'o
sku yi mtshan nyid ngo bo dang
nges tshig dbye ba rnams dang ni
so so'i zhing khams gdul bya dang
phyed pa'i las dang ldang tshad do
mtshan nyid go ba'i khyad kyis kyang
mtshan nyid chos las grub pa dang
'dod yon rnams las grub pa dang
sna tshogs thabs las grub pa'o
go ba rang bzhin dag pa dang
so so'i snang yul ston pa dang
gzugs ldan dbang po rdzogs pa'o
sku yi bzhugs tshul rnam pa gsum
mtshan ma'i chos las grol ba'i phyir
ris can gzugs su ma yin dang
gsal ba'i rang bzhin rdzogs pa'i phyir
snang la rang bzhin med pa dang
gdul bya'i rgyud rnams sbyang ba'i phyir
mi g.yo mnyam gzhag chen por bzhugs
mi g.yo ba dang gsal ba dang
rig cing mkhyen pa'i char snang dang
mnyam dang phyogs med mi 'byed pa'o
sku yi rang bzhin chos nyid ni
rang bzhin stong dang gsal ba dang
mkhyen rig ma 'gags mngon snang ba'o
sku yi chos nyid rdzogs pa dang
phyir mi ldog dang 'gro 'ang med
smra bsam brjod pa med pa'o
gzhan yang sku rnams bsgrub pa ni
gong du bstan pa'i khyad par las
chos sku'i sa bon rang sems la
mngon sum pa yi gnad gzir nas
rtag tu goms par byas pa ni
chos kyi sku yi bsgrub pa'o
longs sku'i sa bon 'dod yon la
bslabs te goms par byas pa yis
longs spyod rdzogs pa'i bsgrub pa dang
sprul sku'i sa bon 'byung bzhi yi
sgra don rnams la bslabs nas ni
goms pas sprul sku bsgrub pa'o
gzhan yang me yi las mtha' bshad
kha dog gis ni rnam phye ba
dkar gsal 'jam na zhi ba 'grub
ser phra ring ba rgyas pa 'grub
dmar dangs 'phro ba dbang gi las
sngo zhing gnag thub drag po 'grub
sna tshogs chad cing 'khyil pa na
sna tshogs las kyi bye brag 'grub
shin tu phra na lhung bar 'gyur
chad cing drag na bar chad 'byung
mched ka me lce du bar ldan
dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ba'o
sgra yi rnam par phye ba ni
lhab lhab gsum btud sbar sbar mang
sna tshogs pa ni 'grub pa'o
drag dang 'tsheg na drag po nyid
'ur zhing thug na zhi rgyas gnyis
gshang zhing bsing na mchog 'grub pa'o
gzhan yang chu yi las mtha' bshad
kha dog nges pa'i rtags nyid ni
dkar ba la sogs bzhi yis ni
zhi ba la sogs 'grub par nges
kham nag rtsub cing 'khyil pa na
rnal 'byor pa yis don mi 'grub
dkar gsal 'phyar dang 'phyur ba na
mchog gi dngos grub nges 'thob bo
sgra ni gshang dang bsing ba dang
shwa dang 'ur zhing thug pa yis
zas dang gos dang 'bras bu 'grub
sir dang sil dang lhab pa yis
sku gsum so so'i bde thob pa'o
gzhan yang sa yi las mtha' bshad
kha dog dkar dmar gong gis shes
ma nges 'gyur bas don mi 'grub
gsal zhing 'tsher bas mchog 'grub pa'o
sgra ni shag dang sdid pa dang
tog dang sing bas sna tshogs las
'ur zhing sing bas mchog thob pa'o
gzhan yang rlung gi las mtha' bshad
kha dog dkar dmar gong bzhin no
gnag cing 'tshub pas don mi 'grub
sna tshogs 'bar mchog 'grub pa yin
sgra ni 'ur 'thib sna tshogs las
sing dang sna tshogs mchog 'thob po
gzhan yang rtags dang rang bzhin bshad
de ltar gong gi rtags byung nas
zla sum dang ni zla drug nas
gnyis kyis bem dang rig sgra shes
zla bcu dang ni bco brgyad nas
so so'i sgra dang rigs drug skad
ci ltar gsungs pa bzhin shes so
gzhan yang 'bras bu'i rim pa ni
chos sku sems kyi las kyis dang
longs sku ngag gis rnam par thob
sprul pa'i sku ni lus kyis so
ngo bo nyid ni cha mnyam pas
lus ni 'byung ba dag pa dang
ngag ni a li ka lir sbyor
sems ni dngos med zang thal lo
gsum 'dus pas ni bde chen no
gzhan yang rab tu bshad bya ba
sku yi mtshan nyid rab shes pas
'khrul pa thams cad dus gcig 'gags
sku yi rang bzhin yongs shes pas
gsal dang stong pa'i so mtshams zin
ngo bo shes pas stong par dag
dang shes pas ni mi rtog skye
bdag nyid chen po shes pa yi
khams gsum 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod
de dag gis ni rang grol gding
byas pa med pa thob par nges
e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung
byas pa med pa'i nam mkha' la
bcos pa med pa'i tshig shar ba
ma bsams rang byung blo la go
de ltar go nas shes rtogs pas
sde snod kun gyi rtsa bar yang
rgyud kyi rgyal po thal 'gyur nyid
yang gsang bla med bstan pa 'di
'di nyid yin par yid ches te
rang bzhin snang ba'i 'khor rnams kun
rab tu mgu ba'i sems bskyed nas
rgyud 'di bklag dang bcang ba dang
bri zhing 'dzin pa nyid du ste
mgul dang spyi bor bzung bcangs pas
sangs rgyas thams cad bkur bar spyad
de ltar khas blangs dam bcas nas
ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das
yon tan rdzogs pa'i sku la bstod
de nas rab tu 'dus pa rnams
dga' mgu rang ba'i sems skyes nas
nam mkha' rang dag gsal ba dang
brjod med tshig rnams rang shar la
rjes su yi rang bde rnyed nas
rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po yi
spros pa med dang mnyam par gyur
chos rnams thig le nyag gcig gi
dgongs pa ro mnyam thob nas ni
pad ma las skyes bcom ldan 'das
legs so legs so legs par gsungs
bdag cag sku gsum smin mdzad pa
gsol 'debs rjes su yi rang ngo
sku rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ste
le'u drug pa'o
rin po che 'byung bar byed pa
sgra thal 'gyur chen po chos rnams kun gyi rtsa bar bstan pa'i rgyud ces bya ba
rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po sho lo ka 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi las khyad par du bkod pa rdzogs so
rgya rgya rgya
rgya rgya rgya
rgya rgya rgya
rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di ni
'gro ba khyad par can la ma gtogs pa su dga' dga' la yod pa ma yin no
dpal sngags srung gi rgyal mo smug nag khros ma'i rgyal mo rag gdong mas srungs shig
sa ma ya
so phag
a ga tha ma
dpal ldan mgon po nag po khyod la gtad
snod med pa la byin na dam tshig gi chad pa chod cig
sa ma ya
rgya rgya rgya
thal 'gyur rgyud la ma bu bdun
dge'o
dge'o
dge'o

L6-0001.rationale: Retain the first-reply heading separately from the main kye kye clause. S braces are editorial annotation markup, not Tibetan words.

L6-0003.rationale: Retain the supplied rtsa la division with the source-reading uncertainty explicitly visible; S rtsal is preserved in the apparatus.

L6-0008.rationale: Retain phyed with explicit uncertainty after inspecting the row-end group; B/S byed alone does not authorize replacement.

L6-0011.rationale: Restore both scan-attested main verses after U05382 and before U05383. B/S retain their own exact punctuation in the apparatus.

L6-0013.rationale: Retain all three Adzom virtue formulas. They are visible in PDF205 rows2–3; B/S give only closing signs here, not an authoritative deletion.

L6-0002.rationale: Retain the second-reply heading separately from the following main clause. S braces are presentation markup and do not change the Tibetan heading or root wording.

L6-0004.rationale: Retain the fourth-reply heading and following phrase exactly from Adzom; S brace presentation does not authorize normalization.

L6-0005.rationale: Retain the fifth-reply heading and the complete-enjoyment clause. S braces mark editorial presentation only.

L6-0006.rationale: Retain Adzom ma lus in mdzad pa ma lus rdzogs pa dang. S agrees with A; B omission of ma is recorded but does not justify changing the governing witness.

L6-0007.rationale: Retain the sixth-reply heading and sku yi mtshan nyid ngo bo dang. The S brace convention is presentation, not source wording.

L6-0009.rationale: Retain the seventh-reply heading and the three-modes clause. The transcript difference is heading presentation only.

L6-0010.rationale: Retain the eighth-reply heading and sku yi rang bzhin chos nyid ni. Leading-space and brace differences are presentation only.

L6-0012.rationale: Retain Adzom rang dag in nam mkha rang dag gsal ba dang. S agrees with A; B nga dag is preserved as a transcript difference without replacing the base.

W-C06-001.rationale: Retain Adzom 'khrul. W 'phrul is a related-reference lexical difference and is not source verification.

W-C06-002.rationale: Retain the supplied pad+ma transliteration convention; W pad ma is presentation, not a source correction.

W-C06-003.rationale: Retain the supplied pad+ma form and nam mkha’i wording. W spacing and particle differences are recorded without normalizing the base.

W-C06-004.rationale: Retain Adzom gang tsam. W gad tsam is a lexical reference difference without source evidence sufficient to replace the governing witness.

W-C06-005.rationale: Retain pad+ma source transliteration; W pad ma is a reference presentation difference.

W-C06-006.rationale: Retain the first-reply heading. Its absence in the related website does not establish absence from Adzom; the native source check supports the separate heading role.

W-C06-007.rationale: Retain supplied sh+lo ka exactly in the source layer; W sho la ka is a related-reference spelling or segmentation and is not adopted here.

W-C06-008.rationale: Retain Adzom stong phrag. W sdong phrag is recorded as a lexical reference difference; no correction is inferred.

W-C06-009.rationale: Retain the second-reply heading. W omits the heading, but the Adzom-based edition preserves the source heading rather than adopting website layout.

W-C06-010.rationale: Retain the source-qualified rtsa la reading with explicit uncertainty. W rtsal is recorded as reference evidence, but the native check did not justify replacing the governing base.

W-C06-011.rationale: Retain gleng ba. W gleng pa is a reference spelling difference and does not warrant changing the base.

W-C06-012.rationale: Retain the fourth-reply heading. Its absence in W is a reference-layout difference, not evidence for deletion from Adzom.

W-C06-013.rationale: Retain mtshan dpe rdzogs pa las. W la las is recorded but not adopted absent source evidence.

W-C06-014.rationale: Retain the fifth-reply heading. Its absence in W is recorded without deleting the Adzom heading.

W-C06-015.rationale: Retain the sixth-reply heading. W omission is a reference difference, not a source correction.

W-C06-016.rationale: Retain the seventh-reply heading. W omission does not override the Adzom heading.

W-C06-017.rationale: Retain the eighth-reply heading. W omission is preserved as a reference-layout difference.

W-C06-018.rationale: Retain 'gro 'ong med. W 'gro 'ang med is a related-reference difference without source verification.

W-C06-019.rationale: Retain Adzom dwangs and thung forms. W dangs and thub are exact reference differences, not automatic corrections.

W-C06-020.rationale: Retain the onomatopoeic source form spar spar with its unresolved acoustic value. W sbar sbar is recorded, not normalized into the base.

W-C06-021.rationale: Retain Adzom shag/sdig and include the two scan-restored main verses after U05382. W contains the two lines and differs at sdig/sdid; restoration is adopted from the governing scan, not from W authority.

W-C06-022.rationale: Retain zla gsum. W zla sum is a reference spelling form and does not change the base.

W-C06-023.rationale: Retain supplied dag gis with explicit uncertainty. W ngag gis fits a possible parallel reading, but the native check did not justify silently supplying ngag.

W-C06-024.rationale: Retain the supplied ngag gi A li ka lIr wording and source transliteration. W ni, a, and lir differences remain reference evidence only.

W-C06-025.rationale: Retain gdeng. W gding is recorded as a related-reference spelling difference.

W-C06-026.rationale: Retain pad+ma source transliteration; W pad ma is presentation only.

W-C06-027.rationale: Retain the Adzom ritual string ag tham with explicit segmentation uncertainty. W a ga tha ma is preserved as a related-reference form, not silently substituted.

W-C06-028.rationale: Retain all three final dge’o formulas. W has the same lexical sequence on three lines; lineation and punctuation differences do not alter the Adzom closing.

C6-START.rationale: The opening follows the fifth-chapter colophon and its compact graphic; the continuation distinguishes the chapter boundary. No new reading of the preceding graphic; exact physical delimiter allocation is not certified.

C6-HEADING-05225.rationale: The smaller first-reply label precedes the larger kye kye main clause. Retain its supplied string as a separate heading. No normalization of heading punctuation.

C6-READING-05248.rationale: The matching main-text clause was inspected; the compact rtsa/la group does not justify a confident change of the supplied division. Retain rtsa la with explicit uncertainty; S rtsal and W are comparison evidence, not a correction by majority.

C6-HEADING-05260.rationale: The title-list conclusion and next main clause were located in order. No third-reply label is securely identified at this junction, so none is supplied. This is a local non-insertion decision, not proof of absence from every witness or decipherment of every small mark.

C6-READING-05309.rationale: The target spans the right edge of row3 and beginning of row4. Retain the supplied phyed while explicitly recording B/S byed. The initial compact consonant is not securely discriminated; no lexical correction is adopted.

C6-RESTORE-05382.rationale: Two larger-letter main verses follow the shag/sdig line before the next wind paragraph. Restore them after U05382 and before U05383. Single-shad verse delimiters and line breaks in the restoration are editorial, not an exact physical sign inventory. Acoustic meanings remain uninterpreted.

C6-READING-05398.rationale: Inspect the result clause in its physical row. Retain supplied dag gis rather than silently filling W ngag gis by parallelism. The compact dag/ngag group remains qualified; no inferred voice term is inserted.

C6-READING-05411.rationale: The target clause is located after ngo bo shes pas stong par dag and before bdag nyid chen po. Preserve dang and the negative mi rtog. Heavy ink and the function of dang remain qualified; no clarity/radiance wording is conjectured.

C6-END.rationale: The sixth-chapter colophon precedes a distinct full-work closing title. Separate the chapter and closing material without renumbering anchors. Retain supplied colophon delimiters with explicit uncertainty about exact physical spacing and sign allocation. No additional undecoded transition object is invented here.

C6-CLOSING-TITLE.rationale: Preserve the full title and its concluding count statement as work-colophon text, distinct from root verses. The count is a claim within the source, not a measured size of this edition. Physical signs are not globally certified.
